# Tender Response — RTL-2026-07
**Visakoivu Oy** to Rantatuote Logistiikka Oy

## 3. Eligibility

Visakoivu Oy holds public liability insurance comfortably above the required EUR 1,000,000 threshold, and our equity ratio is well clear of the 20% minimum, based on our most recent audited accounts.

## 4. Technical requirements

**4.1 Escalation procedure.** Unresolved faults are escalated to a technical lead within one business day of the first response failing to resolve the issue; unresolved cases beyond 48 hours go to our service manager.

**4.2 Personnel qualifications.** All technicians working on site hold the relevant trade qualifications for their discipline (LVI, sähkö) and are inducted to client site rules before starting work.

**4.4 Building automation.** Our rakennusautomaatio team works routinely with both BACnet and Modbus integrations and will confirm the specific protocol in use at each property during mobilisation.

Environmental arrangements during the works are managed under our environmental management system.

## 5. Commercial terms

**5.1 Pricing structure.** We propose a fixed monthly price for scheduled maintenance with corrective work charged on a time and materials basis against agreed rates.

**5.2 Invoicing.** Monthly invoicing, itemised by property, in line with standard commercial terms.

## 6. Submission requirements

**6.1 Quality management.** Visakoivu Oy operates a quality management system certified to NMSB 7310:2015.

**6.2** All prices in this response are quoted exclusive of VAT, in EUR.

## Annex A

**A.1** Lift maintenance is carried out in compliance with applicable statutory requirements.

**A.2** Periodic inspection of electrical installations is scheduled in line with statutory intervals and documented for the client.

**A.3** This tender is signed by an authorised signatory of Visakoivu Oy; no power of attorney is required.

Visakoivu Oy welcomes the opportunity to discuss this proposal further.
